name: De Morgan's Obfuscation
description: Replaces the direct implication logic ("if A fails, B is forced") with a negative exclusion rule based on De Morgan's laws ("failure occurs if both A and B yield warnings"). This prevents the model from directly mapping the text to implication graph edges, forcing it to manually deduce that avoiding a NAND of negations is equivalent to a logical OR, disrupting standard 2-SAT template matching.
